args.label: c1
args.task: Check claim-1: README.md in the repo root starts with the line "# eval repo". Answer with a line 'VERDICT: CONFIRMED' or 'VERDICT: REFUTED' and a line 'EVIDENCE: ...'.

args.label: c2
args.task: Check claim-2: gate.sh in the repo root is a Python script. Answer with a line 'VERDICT: CONFIRMED' or 'VERDICT: REFUTED' and a line 'EVIDENCE: ...'.

calls.bash: echo o1 >> o1.txt && git add o1.txt && git commit -qm o1
mu task close o1 -w eval --evidence 'did o1 myself'
for i in $(seq 1 120); do c=0; for n in 1 2; do mu task notes c$n -w eval 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'VERDICT:' && c=$((c+1)); done; [ $c -ge 2 ] && break; sleep 1; done; echo verdicts=$c
v=$(mu task notes c1 -w eval | grep -o 'VERDICT: [A-Z]*' | tail -1); case "$v" in *CONFIRMED) mu task close c1 -w eval --evidence "checked: $v" ;; esac
v=$(mu task notes c2 -w eval | grep -o 'VERDICT: [A-Z]*' | tail -1); case "$v" in *REFUTED) mu task close c2 -w eval --as rejected --why 'claim refuted' --evidence "checked: $v" ;; esac
